program.section_heading: ESL Milestone Certificate- Pathway to Transfer: Language Arts/Oral Communication
outcomes: Acquire the knowledge and skills, including academic English-language reading and writing at a post-secondary level, and introductory principles and theories of effective speech communication, computer-mediated communication, and new technologies, necessary for college coursework towards degree, certificate, or transfer in Communication Studies.

notes: The heading 'Complete one Communication Studies course (3 units):' is printed twice; the first instance sits above the three ESL courses, which appears to be a catalog misprint. Because ESL 107 C + ESL 108 C + ESL 109 C (15 units) plus one COMM course (3 units) equals the printed 18-unit total, the ESL courses were read as all required. The first block's stated total was left null, since its printed '3 units' does not fit those courses. A reviewer should check this reading.
ESL 107 C is not in the closed list and is recorded as a catalog addition.
No units are printed beside the alternatives COMM C1000H and COMM 110 C, so their units are null.
The outcome was printed with the label 'OUTCOME 1:', which was omitted from the record.
The award type in the request (16-30 units) is consistent with the 18-unit total printed on the page.
